t: This is Altab Ali Park, a small park on the Whitechapel Road. It was once called St Mary's Park, and it's the site of the old fourteenth-century church of St Mary Matfelon, which gave Whitechapel its name. Richard Parker is buried here. He was the sailor executed in 1797 as president of the so-called Floating Republic, the naval mutiny at the Nore. The park is named after Altab Ali, a Bangladeshi textile worker who was murdered in a racist attack in 1978. His death sparked outrage and community action against racism.
